title: Welcome to Nocturne Broadcast! 🚀
content:
Hey everyone! 👋 Welcome to the official Nocturne Announcements channel.

Here you'll get direct updates on upcoming features, releases, hotfixes, and changelogs straight from the developer. React to this message to show your excitement!

title: Nocturne v2.22.28 is out! 🚀
content:
Hey everyone! 👋 We just released Nocturne **v2.22.28** with Zero-Cache Real-Time Live Cloud Announcements!

• **Instant Live Announcements**: Real-time broadcasts delivered with zero delay.
• **Grouped-List Design**: Unified sleek containers with rounded top/bottom corners.
• **Connected Auto-Playlists**: Liked, Downloaded, Top 50, and Cached in Library.
• **Battery Optimization Controls**: Prevent playback terminations in background.

Update now from Settings -> Check for update!

title: Message from the Developer
content:
Dear App Users, ❤️🎧

First of all, I genuinely want to say I’m sorry for pushing so many updates all at once. 🙏😅 I know getting multiple updates within a short period can feel annoying or confusing, especially when you just want to open the app and enjoy your music without having to worry about another update.

But there was a reason behind all of it. ❤️‍🩹

Over the past few days, some of you experienced playback errors, random glitches, crashes, unexpected behavior, or issues while using different parts of the app. 🐛⚠️ And honestly, I didn’t want to simply leave those problems there and move on.

Every update was made with one goal in mind: to make the app better, more stable, smoother, and more reliable for everyone. 🚀✨

I’ve been working on fixing the underlying issues, improving playback stability, polishing different parts of the experience, and making sure the app feels much more consistent than before. 🔧🎶

And now, after all these improvements, I’m 100% confident that the major issues that were affecting users have been addressed. 💯🔥

Of course, no software is ever truly perfect, and if you somehow come across a problem, please don’t hesitate to report it. Your feedback is extremely valuable because it helps me understand what needs to be improved next. 🫶

So once again, thank you for your patience, your feedback, your bug reports, and most importantly, your support. ❤️

I know the updates came one after another, but every single one of them was made because I genuinely want this app to become something better with every release. 🌙✨

Now the hard part is done. 😭😂
All I need from here is YOUR support. ❤️‍🔥

Keep using the app, keep sharing your feedback, and keep supporting the journey. There’s still a lot more to come. 🚀🎧

Thank you for being here. ❤️
Thank you for trusting the app. 🤝
And thank you for supporting the journey. 🌟

More improvements. More features. More stability.
And a much better experience ahead. 🚀🔥

— The Developer ❤️

Once Again Enjoy this seamless music experience with nocturne 
                           -Mudassir  Nocturne Developer

title: Important Notice for Vivo & iQOO Users
content:
🚨 Important Notice for Vivo & iQOO Users

If Nocturne is crashing on your Vivo or iQOO device, please try the following workaround:

Go to Nocturne → Settings → Appearance → Force 90/120Hz

👉 Turn OFF “Force 90/120Hz” and then restart the app.

This setting may be causing crashes on some Vivo and iQOO devices. We’re investigating the issue and working towards a proper fix. 🛠️

If you’re experiencing crashes, please try this workaround first and let us know if it resolves the problem.

Thank you for your patience and continued support! ❤️🎵

🚨 Nocturne 2.22.29 Crash Bug Fixed! 🎉

The crash issue affecting some Vivo and iQOO devices has been fixed in the latest update. 🛠️✨

Please update Nocturne to version 2.22.29 to get the latest fixes and stability improvements.

To update:

Nocturne → Settings → Check for Updates → Update

👉 If an update is available, please install it and restart the app afterward.

We highly recommend updating, especially if you were experiencing crashes or issues with the Force 90/120Hz setting.

Thank you for your patience and continued support! ❤️🎵

📢 NOCTURNE USER ANNOUNCEMENT

Hey Nocturne users! 🎧💜

I need your honest feedback! Your reviews are extremely important for us because they help us understand how Nocturne is actually performing for you and where we can improve the overall experience.

Please take a few minutes to share your honest review about Nocturne on Up to Down and on the Nocturne website. ⭐

Tell us what you think about:
🎵 Music & playback experience
⚡ App performance & speed
🎨 UI/UX and overall design
🔍 Features and functionality
📱 Overall user experience
🐛 Any bugs or issues you faced
💡 What you would like to see improved or added

Whether your experience has been amazing, average, or you faced some problems, please be honest. We genuinely want to hear from you.

Your feedback directly helps us make Nocturne better with every update. ❤️‍🔥

So please don't skip this, leave your review on both Up to Down and the Nocturne website.

Thank you for supporting Nocturne and being part of this journey! 🫶🎧

Your feedback. Our improvement. One better Nocturne. 🚀

Dear users! 🎧✨

We’re working on bringing Hi Res Lossless audio to the app, but running this at scale requires proper server funding and infrastructure. Without that, we unfortunately can’t provide Apple Music level Hi Res Lossless quality. 💿🔥

That said, we’ve also added support for self hosted servers, so you can set up and configure your own server according to your needs. 🖥️⚙️

In the meantime, we’re continuously working on improving the YouTube client and optimizing audio quality so you can still get the cleanest and best sounding experience possible. 🎶🚀

Thank you for your support and understanding! ❤️

We’re also working on increasing the playlist import limit to up to 10,000 songs. We’ll roll this out once we’re sure it stays stable and scalable under testing.

We’ve also added Audio Enhancement, which you can configure according to your own taste and listening preference. 🎧🔥

Hey everyone! ❤️

We’ve reached 409 downloads on GitHub! 🚀

If you’re enjoying the app and find it useful, I’d really appreciate it if you could take a moment to ⭐ star the GitHub repository. It helps the project grow and means a lot to me as a developer.

Thank you for supporting the project! 🙌
